maitriStationSummary: India’s year-round Antarctic base in the rocky Schirmacher Oasis. Researchers use it as a field base for studies across the polar environment.
bharatiStationSummary: India’s second active Antarctic station, built near the coast at Larsemann Hills to support year-round polar research.
himadriStationSummary: India’s Arctic research station at the international Ny-Ålesund research base. The Arctic programme studies climate, ocean and polar processes.
